items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: he always wanted to get a band together and have Dave Bartholomew himself and me, for the three trumpet players. But he never did get it together. Because I always had my band and Dave had his band.

ctx.x: Hardin, H-A-R-D-I-N? Yeah. Were you first of friends with Clyde Kerr?

Well, we used to talk a lot. And he always wanted to get a band together and have Dave Bartholomew himself and me, for the three trumpet players. But he never did get it together. Because I always had my band and Dave had his band. Right. But Clyde, he wasn't a jazz player. Anything that you write down, he can play it. But I mean just to sit down and play one of those jobs on Bourbon Street. Right. Or you have to improvise. He never did have jobs like that.
